items.e: And it came to pass at midnight, that the Lord smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt , etc.; and it is written, For all the first-born among the children of Israel are Mine, both men and beast; on the day that I smote all the first-born in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for Myself . R. Joḥanan said: Although He smote them with the plague of death at midnight, the souls writhed within them until morning. A common proverb says, ‘If you give a morsel of bread to a child, inform his mother’. Likewise, the Holy One, blessed be He, said, ‘I will inform My children of the death by choking of which their enemies are dying. Let their souls await the morning [before expiring], so that My children shall look upon [the fate of] their enemies’.
